name: Zach Nunn
stance: Backs one national AI standard under the White House framework, proposes a bipartisan AI Commission on national-security threats, and sponsors the AI Plan Act on AI-driven threats.

statements.text: This framework is the next step: one national standard that protects families, drives innovation, and keeps Iowa innovators ahead in the global AI race.
AI development is moving too quickly for another study.
Submitted a plan to congressional leadership for a bipartisan AI Commission on national security, and questioned Treasury Secretary Bessent on keeping China from leapfrogging US frontier models.

The Administration's 120-day AI task force reflects key priorities of my bipartisan AI Plan Act, including identifying emerging threats, coordinating with industry partners, and developing a national response.
